transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?
I've been having a really hard time staying in my seat lately, and I find myself constantly getting up when I'm supposed to be sitting still. It's making it very difficult for me
Do you also have trouble paying attention, staying organized, or finishing tasks because you get distracted easily?

Yes, I have a really hard time sustaining my attention on tasks and often end up leaving them unfinished. I also tend to be very forgetful in my daily routine, which makes it incredibly difficult to stay organized.
Did these attention and hyperactivity symptoms start before age 12, and have they been present for at least 6 months?
Yes, they definitely started before I turned 12, even back when I was in elementary school. Lately, it has been a constant struggle for about two years and five months now.

latest_inference.note: Previously the only candidate was Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (Combined Presentation). The interview now confirms both inattention (difficulty sustaining attention, unfinished tasks, forgetfulness, disorganization) and hyperactivity/impulsivity (can’t stay seated, frequently getting up), with onset before age 12 and duration well over 6 months. No evidence has emerged for an alternative diagnosis, so the candidate list remains unchanged.

final_diagnosis.reason: Patient reports both prominent hyperactivity/impulsivity symptoms (difficulty staying seated, frequently getting up when expected to sit still) and inattentive symptoms (poor sustained attention, unfinished tasks, forgetfulness, disorganization). Symptoms began before age 12 and have persisted for well over 6 months, supporting ADHD combined presentation.
